rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a completed work of art, literature, or music.

example.traditional: 呢件作品真係好有感染力。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 zok3 ban2 zan1 hai6 hou2 jau5 gam2 jim5 lik6

rows.note: Use this for an essay, especially a school or exam essay.

example.english: I spent the whole afternoon writing this composition.
example.traditional: 呢篇作文我寫咗成個下午。
example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 zok3 man4 ngo5 se2 zo2 sing4 go3 haa6 ng5

rows.note: Use this for the inherent nature or general character of a thing or person, rather than its individual components.

example.english: The composition of this material is relatively stable.
example.traditional: 呢種材料嘅性質比較穩定。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 coi4 liu6 ge3 sing3 zat1 bei2 gaau3 wan2 ding6

rows.note: Use this when the composition means the components or makeup of a thing, especially a substance or mixture.

example.english: The composition of this fruit juice is written on the bottle.
example.traditional: 呢樽果汁嘅成分寫喺樽身。
example.jyutping: ni1 zeon1 gwo2 zap1 ge3 sing4 fan6 se2 hai2 zeon1 san1
